question_text: A 71-year-old man comes to the physician for a routine health maintenance examination. He has occasional fatigue but otherwise feels well. He has a history of hypertension and type 2 diabetes mellitus. He is a retired chemist. His only medication is ramipril. His temperature is 37.8°C (100°F), pulse is 72/min, respirations are 18/min, and blood pressure is 130/70 mm Hg. Physical examination shows nontender cervical and axillary lymphadenopathy. The spleen is palpated 7 cm below the costal margin. Laboratory studies show a leukocyte count of 12,000/mm3 and a platelet count of 210,000/mm3. Further evaluation is most likely to show which of the following?
